$schema_note: TRIZ 39 Engineering Parameters with a curated engineer-vocabulary alias thesaurus. ENGINEERING-DOMAIN ONLY — these parameters and the contradiction matrix do not fit software/UX/organizational problems (use separation principles + function analysis there). Source: classical Altshuller parameter set; names/glosses verified against MATRIZ. Aliases are original (this project).

parameters.name: Weight of moving object
parameters.gloss: Mass of a movable object; the force it exerts in motion.

parameters.name: Weight of stationary object
parameters.gloss: Mass of a non-moving object.

parameters.name: Length of moving object
parameters.gloss: A linear dimension of a movable object.

parameters.name: Length of stationary object
parameters.gloss: A linear dimension of a stationary object.

parameters.name: Area of moving object
parameters.gloss: Surface/area of a movable object.

parameters.name: Area of stationary object
parameters.gloss: Surface/area of a stationary object.

parameters.name: Volume of moving object
parameters.gloss: Cubic space occupied by a movable object.

parameters.name: Volume of stationary object
parameters.gloss: Cubic space occupied by a stationary object.

parameters.name: Speed
parameters.gloss: Velocity of an object or the rate of a process.

parameters.name: Force (Intensity)
parameters.gloss: Any interaction intended to change an object's state.

parameters.name: Stress or Pressure
parameters.gloss: Force per unit area; tension.

parameters.name: Shape
parameters.gloss: External contours or appearance.

parameters.name: Stability of the object's composition
parameters.gloss: Wholeness and integrity of the system and its elements.

parameters.name: Strength
parameters.gloss: Resistance to changing under an applied force.

parameters.name: Duration of action of moving object
parameters.gloss: How long a movable object keeps performing; service life.

parameters.name: Duration of action of stationary object
parameters.gloss: Service life of a stationary object.

parameters.name: Temperature
parameters.gloss: Thermal condition of the system.

parameters.name: Illumination intensity
parameters.gloss: Light flux per unit area; lighting quality.

parameters.name: Use of energy by moving object
parameters.gloss: Energy a movable object consumes to do its work.

parameters.name: Use of energy by stationary object
parameters.gloss: Energy a stationary object consumes.

parameters.name: Power
parameters.gloss: Rate at which work is performed; rate of energy use.

parameters.name: Loss of energy
parameters.gloss: Energy not contributing to useful work.

parameters.name: Loss of substance
parameters.gloss: Partial or total loss of a system's materials.

parameters.name: Loss of information
parameters.gloss: Loss of data or access to it.

parameters.name: Loss of time
parameters.gloss: Wasted time; interval beyond the ideal minimum.

parameters.name: Quantity of substance
parameters.gloss: Amount or number of materials/subsystems.

parameters.name: Reliability
parameters.gloss: Ability to perform its functions predictably.

parameters.name: Measurement accuracy
parameters.gloss: Closeness of a measured value to the true value.

parameters.name: Manufacturing precision
parameters.gloss: Degree actual characteristics match the specification.

parameters.name: Object-affected harmful factor
parameters.gloss: Susceptibility to externally generated harm.

parameters.name: Object-generated harmful factor
parameters.gloss: Harm the object itself generates as it operates.

parameters.name: Ease of manufacture
parameters.gloss: Convenience of fabricating or assembling.

parameters.name: Ease of operation
parameters.gloss: Simplicity of operation; few steps/operators/tools.

parameters.name: Ease of repair
parameters.gloss: Convenience, time, and cost of fixing faults.

parameters.name: Adaptability or versatility
parameters.gloss: Responds to change; usable in multiple ways.

parameters.name: Device complexity
parameters.gloss: Number and diversity of elements and interrelations.

parameters.name: Difficulty of detecting and measuring
parameters.gloss: Complexity and cost of monitoring and measuring.

parameters.name: Extent of automation
parameters.gloss: Degree the system runs without human intervention.

parameters.name: Productivity
parameters.gloss: Useful output or operations per unit time.
